collection_window_note: Each original candidate T through T+1 plus 20 strict SSE sessions, capped at the fixed as-of. This is an evidence budget, not a forced-exit rule. Unobserved intervening sessions and any unobserved later exit remain unresolved.

source_policy.collection_order: After endpoint canaries, finish every required daily/stk_limit session before optional adj_factor collection uses the remaining budget.
source_policy.daily_prices: unadjusted official-source daily bars; open-price research proxy, not actual fills
source_policy.limits: provider official dated limit prices, never inferred fixed 10 percent
source_policy.adjustment: diagnostic evidence only; no automatic dividend/share-action reconstruction
source_policy.missingness: unknown, never cash zero or presumed suspension
source_policy.raw_response_role: retrieved now for retrospective labels; not evidence available at historical D and not new forward records
source_policy.optional_permission_failure: record unavailable and continue required sources without upgrading account permissions
source_policy.required_source_failure: stop and publish a failure receipt, never substitute older data

next_stage: Verify artifact/run/source hashes and overlapping official partitions, rebuild labels in a separate research snapshot, then apply the unchanged v2 complete-D and training gates. No automatic production replacement.
